body: AUTHOR REVIEW COMPLETE — ACCEPT, no fix-forward required. Reviewed current storymodel4s main 5be5717; the shared placement sources remain unchanged from landed d2a1abb. The ordering is semantically right for Codex and Atlas, including Atlas-only coarse projections: selected-object visibility is checked first; primaryParent contains only horizon-visible containment claims; VisibleAncestorChain admits each segment only when its summary claim and clipped support are visible; traversal stops at the first hidden segment; only then does Atlas search the truncated chain for a marked ancestor. ViaAncestor therefore means a fully warranted visible containment route, not merely that a coarse region exists. Crossing a hidden intermediate would disclose precisely the structure ReaderAt suppresses. Cycle handling is bounded, and validated hierarchy supplies the stronger acyclicity invariant. Independent current-tip gate: CodexCompilerSuite 9/9 and WarOfTheGhostsCodexCompilerSuite 18/18. Sibling behavioural seam also green: storyatlas4s c9f9e36 against storymodel4s 5be5717, intaglio 596b398, grakern 0329c43; full sbt test 95/95 total across modules, zero failures/errors. I agree with the chief ruling and the named S / hidden P1 / marked P2 regression.
